articles.title: Health Benefits Brokers Pursue New Cost-Containment Strategies Amid Rising Expenses
articles.summary: Insurance brokers and consultants are actively seeking alternative health plan strategies to combat soaring healthcare and pharmacy costs for employer clients. This shift highlights growing demand among self-funded employers for innovative PBM models, transparent pricing, and specialized cost-management solutions.
articles.source_line: Source: Insurance Journal; Mon, 05 Oct 2026 12:30:15 GMT

articles.title: FDA Approves Additional Manufacturing Capacity for Alvotech Humira Biosimilar
articles.summary: The FDA has approved expanded manufacturing capacity for Alvotech's Humira biosimilar, bolstering supply chain stability for a key high-cost specialty drug. This increased manufacturing capacity supports broader market adoption of biosimilars, offering self-funded employer health plans enhanced opportunities to drive significant cost savings on specialty pharmacy spend.

articles.title: Bipartisan Congressional Scrutiny Mounts Against Pharmacy Benefit Managers
articles.summary: Lawmakers from both parties are increasingly uniting in their criticism and legislative efforts targeting pharmacy benefit managers (PBMs). This heightened bipartisan scrutiny signals a growing risk of federal reform regarding PBM pricing models, transparency, and rebate practices, directly impacting self-funded employer health plans.
